verdict.rationale: uv provides dedicated CLI commands (`uv add`, `uv remove`, `uv lock --upgrade-package`) that programmatically update both pyproject.toml and uv.lock, exactly the kind of safe manifest/lockfile rewrite an agent would invoke instead of hand-editing files, and this is corroborated by community reports of uv 'just working' for dependency management. missing for 10: no explicit hands-on evidence of an agent-driven workflow using these commands, and no discussion of safety guarantees against manual lockfile edits.
